note: Year A runs from Nov 30, 2025 - Nov 29, 2026. Each entry represents a Sunday or major feast.

sundays.keyVerse: I am the resurrection and the life; whoever believes in me, even if he dies, will live.
sundays.meditation: Jesus raises Lazarus from death, revealing His divine power over the grave. This miracle points to His own resurrection and ours. Today, bring your 'dead' situations to Jesus—the broken relationships, lost hope, impossible circumstances. He is the resurrection and the life.

sundays.keyVerse: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?
sundays.meditation: As we enter Holy Week, we witness Christ's ultimate act of love. From the triumphal entry to the passion and death, Jesus surrenders completely to the Father's will. This week, walk with Him through the darkness. His suffering reveals the depth of God's love and the cost of our redemption.

The tomb is empty! Death could not hold Him. Christ's resurrection is the foundation of our faith and the promise of our own resurrection. Today, let Easter joy transform your life. What seemed impossible—victory over death—is now reality. Alleluia! All things are possible with God.
